scope: Local evaluator artifact-safety repair; synthetic fixtures with fitting intercepted

source_identity.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source after CRLF-to-LF normalization

contract.failure: A failed run retains an incomplete reservation that cannot be reused; nonfinite results are rejected before JSON is written
output_identity: evaluator settings and feature lists with configuration hash
contract.destination: Explicit new path; existing files and final-path symlinks rejected; exclusive creation reserves the output before fitting
contract.input: Explicit PIT training artifact; shared manifest, hash, schema, feature-order and label-time validation before fitting
contract.additional_checks: Binary evaluator labels, current eligibility and minimum interval count

verification.scope_note: Overlapping runs, not additive totals. All nine focused cases use synthetic inputs and intercept model fitting.
verification.independent_source_review: No actionable defect found within evaluator artifact-safety scope

limits: No actual component evaluation, real-data fitting, new model, metric recomputation or fresh holdout was performed.

No compatible real PIT dataset or model was produced. Historical metrics and artifacts remain unchanged.
No MMG deployment or hosted acceptance follows from these checks.
Exclusive output creation is not a power-loss durability guarantee or protection against concurrent mutation of input or source files.
